description: This file defines a React component 'MessageActions' for rendering action buttons (like edit, copy, pin, delete, resend, stop) associated with chat messages. It manages user interactions such as editing message content, copying text, pinning messages, resending messages, stopping message generation, and deleting messages within a chat interface. It also references icons, localization, utilities, and store management for chat sessions.

methods.name: genActionsShema
methods.description: Generates an array of action configurations (such as edit, copy, pin, delete, retry, stop) for the message action buttons, customizing their icons, labels, classes, and click handlers.

methods.name: deleteMessage
methods.description: Removes a message from the current chat session based on its ID.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles message deletion by invoking deleteMessage with the message's ID.

methods.name: onResend
methods.description: Handles resending a message by finding the original user and assistant messages, deleting them, and triggering a new user input.

methods.name: onPinMessage
methods.description: Pins the message to the chat context and optionally shows a prompt modal.

methods.name: onUserStop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing message response generation for a specific message.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Allows editing the message content via a prompt and updates the message in the current session.

methods.name: onCopy
methods.description: Copies the message text content to clipboard.
